import_provenance.original_title: Verifiable random functions from one-way functions alone
import_provenance.original_statement: Do one-way functions suffice to construct fully adaptively secure, publicly verifiable random functions on exponentially large input domains in the standard model? This asks whether the extra algebraic assumptions in constructions such as Dodis–Yampolskiy can be eliminated.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial foundational extension of his VRF work. Known black-box separations from one-way permutations rule out that approach, rather than settling the unrestricted implication.
